questions.title: Count Target Pairs
questions.description:
Given an array of n integers and a target, count the number of pairs (i, j), i < j, such that a[i] + a[j] == target.

Example 1:
Input: nums = [1,5,7,-1,5], target = 6
Output: 3
Explanation: Pairs (1,5), (7,-1), and the second 5 with 1.

Example 2:
Input: nums = [1,1,1,1], target = 2
Output: 6
questions.inputFormat: First line: n and target. Second line: n space-separated integers.
questions.outputFormat: A single integer — the number of valid pairs.

driverCode.python:
import sys
def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n, t = int(data[0]), int(data[1])
    nums = list(map(int, data[2:2 + n]))
    print(Solution().countPairs(nums, t))
main()

questions.title: Longest Subarray with Sum K
questions.description:
Given an array of integers and an integer K, return the length of the longest contiguous subarray whose sum equals K. Return 0 if none exists.

Example 1:
Input: nums = [10,5,2,7,1,9], k = 15
Output: 4
Explanation: [5,2,7,1] sums to 15 and has length 4.
questions.inputFormat: First line: n and k. Second line: n space-separated integers.
questions.outputFormat: A single integer — the length of the longest such subarray.

driverCode.python:

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
